items.name: Bourbon
items.description: An American whiskey made primarily from corn (at least 51%) and aged in new charred oak barrels. It delivers rich caramel, vanilla, and charred oak flavors with a smooth sweetness, forming the backbone of classics like the Old Fashioned and Mint Julep.

items.name: Rye Whiskey
items.description: Whiskey with a majority of rye grain, known for a drier, spicier character of pepper and baking spice. Its bold, spicy bite cuts through the sweetness and bitters in cocktails like the Manhattan or Sazerac, keeping these classics crisp and balanced.

items.name: Blended Scotch
items.description: A mix of malt and grain whiskies from Scotland combined for a smooth, consistent profile (often with just a whisper of smoke). Lighter-bodied than most single malts, it's versatile for sipping neat or mixing into highballs and other Scotch-based drinks.

items.name: Islay Scotch
items.description: Single malt whisky from Scotland's Islay region, famous for intense peat smoke, sea-spray brine, and medicinal notes. Bold and smoky, it's cherished by peat lovers as a sipper and used sparingly in cocktails like the Penicillin to add a dramatic smoky depth.

items.name: Single Malt Scotch
items.description: Whisky made at one Scottish distillery from 100% malted barley, often showcasing that distillery's unique character. Typically complex and smooth (ranging from fruity and floral to heavily peated), it's prized for sipping or for adding refined depth to spirit-forward cocktails like a Rob Roy.

items.name: Irish Whiskey
items.description: Easy-drinking whiskey from Ireland, usually triple-distilled for smoothness and often a blend of malt and grain. Light, mellow, and gently fruity with hints of honey and oak, it's approachable neat or on ice and adds a soft touch to drinks like the Irish Coffee.

items.name: Canadian Whisky
items.description: Blended whisky from Canada, often made with corn and a touch of rye, famed for its ultra-smooth, light character. With subtle sweetness and gentle spice, it's an all-purpose mixer for highballs and cocktails, and an easygoing sip on its own.

items.name: Japanese Whisky
items.description: Refined whisky crafted in Japan, inspired by Scotch tradition but perfected with Japanese precision. Typically silky and balanced with delicate smoke or sherry-cask notes, it's highly sippable neat and elevates simple cocktails like the Whisky Highball with its elegance.

items.name: Tennessee Whiskey
items.description: A bourbon-style whiskey from Tennessee that undergoes charcoal mellowing (Lincoln County Process) before barreling. It shares bourbon's corn-rich sweetness and vanilla oak smoothness, with a touch of charcoal depth (as exemplified by Jack Daniel's), making it great in classic American whiskey cocktails.

items.name: American Single Malt
items.description: A growing category of U.S. whiskey made from 100% malted barley at one distillery (much like a Scotch single malt). It marries rich malty depth with American innovation, yielding flavors from chocolate and caramel to smoky oak, enjoyed neat or in upscale whiskey cocktails.

items.name: Blended Malt Scotch
items.description: A Scotch whisky composed only of single malts from multiple distilleries (no grain whisky), also called a 'vatted malt.' It offers a harmonized all-malt flavor—complex yet rounded—and is often enjoyed like a single malt or used to add depth in a cocktail without introducing grain spirits.

items.name: Highland Single Malt Scotch
items.description: Single malt whisky from Scotland's Highland region, generally robust and malty with notes of heather, spice, and fruit. This broad category ranges from delicate to full-bodied, but typically delivers a warm, rounded profile that's versatile for sipping or mixing into spirit-forward cocktails.

items.name: Speyside Single Malt Scotch
items.description: Single malts from Speyside, Scotland's most prolific whisky region, known for smooth and elegant profiles. Often honeyed and fruity with hints of vanilla or sherry sweetness and minimal smoke, they are crowd-pleasing sippers that also lend gentle complexity to spirit-forward cocktails.

items.name: Fireball Cinnamon Whiskey
items.description: A whiskey-based liqueur infused with sweet and fiery cinnamon flavor, bottled at a low 33% ABV. More of a party shooter than a craft cocktail ingredient, its candy-like spice can add a fun kick to simple mixed drinks or seasonal punches when used in moderation.

items.name: Gin
items.description: A generic gin option for recipes that don't specify a particular gin style. When a recipe simply calls for 'gin', this is the default match.

items.name: London Dry Gin
items.description: Crisp, juniper-forward classic gin style with no added sweeteners after distillation. Its dry, botanical profile makes it the versatile base for staples like the Martini and Gin & Tonic.

items.name: Old Tom Gin
items.description: A lightly sweetened 18th-century gin style, softer and less juniper-intense than London Dry. Bridging malty genever and dry gin, it's ideal for historic cocktails like the Tom Collins that benefit from its subtle sweetness.

items.name: Plymouth Gin
items.description: A historic style from Plymouth, England, known for a balanced, earthy botanical mix and a slightly softer juniper profile. Smoother and more citrus-forward than a London Dry, it works well in martinis and adds a rounded character to any gin cocktail.

items.name: Genever
items.description: The Dutch predecessor to modern gin, distilled from a malted grain mash with juniper and other botanicals. It has a fuller, malty body with a touch of sweetness, often enjoyed neat or in classic cocktails where its whiskey-like richness shines.

items.name: Navy Strength Gin
items.description: Overproof gin (around 57% ABV) originally made for British naval officers, packing intense botanical concentration. Its higher alcohol amplifies bold juniper and spice flavors, holding up in punchy cocktails and adding a robust kick to classics.

items.name: Sloe Gin
items.description: A ruby-red liqueur made by infusing gin with sloe berries (wild plums) and sugar, yielding tart berry and almond notes. Lower in alcohol and sweet-tart in flavor, it's used as a fruity modifier in drinks like the Sloe Gin Fizz for a crimson twist.

items.name: Contemporary Gin
items.description: Modern gin styles that de-emphasize juniper, showcasing citrus, floral, or herbal botanicals more prominently. These 'New Western' gins offer unique flavor profiles, lending creative twists to cocktails and appealing to those less fond of the traditional juniper punch.

items.name: Barrel-Aged Gin
items.description: Gin that's rested in wood casks, picking up a touch of color and whiskey-like complexity from the oak. The aging smooths the gin's edges and imparts vanilla or spice notes, creating a hybrid spirit great for sipping or adding depth to classic gin cocktails like the Negroni.

items.name: White Rum
items.description: Clear, light-bodied rum that is typically unaged (or briefly aged and filtered) for a clean taste. With a subtle cane sweetness and a hint of vanilla, it's the backbone of tropical cocktails like the Daiquiri and Mojito, providing alcohol without heavy flavor.

items.name: Gold Rum
items.description: Light amber rum that's usually aged a short time (or has a hint of caramel added) to develop a mild golden color and flavor. Smoother and more flavorful than white rum, it brings gentle notes of vanilla and caramel, making it a go-to for mixed drinks like a Mai Tai or Rum Punch where extra depth is desired.

items.name: Dark Rum
items.description: Deep-colored rum often aged longer or with added molasses/caramel for color and intensity, yielding rich notes of molasses, toffee, and spice. Full-bodied and robust, it's used in bold drinks like the Dark 'n Stormy or floated on tropical cocktails to add weighty sweetness and complexity.

items.name: Aged Rum
items.description: Rum matured for several years in oak barrels, developing complexity akin to a fine whiskey. Expect smooth notes of oak, vanilla, and dried fruit; premium aged rums are great for sipping neat or elevating classic rum cocktails (like a Rum Old Fashioned) with their depth.

items.name: Overproof Rum
items.description: Potent rum bottled at higher-than-normal strength (often 50-75% ABV), far stronger than standard 40% rums. It packs a boozy punch and concentrated flavor, so it's used sparingly in Tiki drinks like the Zombie or as a float/garnish, adding fiery intensity beyond what normal rum provides.

items.name: Jamaican Rum
items.description: Pot-still rum from Jamaica famous for its heavy 'funk' (high esters) that gives off overripe banana, pineapple, and other intensely funky aromas. This intensely flavorful style (a little goes a long way) adds exotic depth to tropical cocktails and is the cornerstone of many Tiki recipes like Planter's Punch.

items.name: Demerara Rum
items.description: Rum from Guyana's Demerara region, known for a dark, smoky-sweet profile with notes of burnt sugar, toffee, and wood spice. Heavy-bodied and rich (e.g., El Dorado rums), it provides a lush, caramelized backbone to tropical libations and stands up well in full-flavored cocktails.

items.name: Rhum Agricole
items.description: French Caribbean rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice (not molasses), typically from Martinique. It has a grassy, earthy brightness with vegetal and floral hints—a vibrant departure from molasses rums that shines in cocktails like the Ti' Punch or a distinctive Daiquiri.

items.name: Cachaça
items.description: Brazil's national spirit, also made from fresh sugarcane juice, with a rustic, earthy edge. Generally unaged or lightly aged, it has grassy and fruity notes with a funkier bite than most rum, and is the essential base for a Caipirinha (Brazil's signature cocktail).

items.name: Cuban-Style White Rum
items.description: A smooth, light-bodied rum in the Cuban tradition (think Havana Club or Bacardi), often column-distilled and charcoal-filtered. Clean in taste with subtle hints of cane and citrus, it's perfect for Cuban classics like the Daiquiri and Mojito where a delicate rum lets other flavors shine.

items.name: Barbados Rum
items.description: Balanced rum from Barbados, typically a blend of pot and column still distillates aged without heavy additives. Renowned for a mellow harmony of vanilla, toasted sugar, and tropical fruit notes, it's versatile—smooth enough to sip straight and flavorful enough to uplift any rum cocktail.

items.name: Demerara Overproof Rum
items.description: A high-proof rum from Guyana combining Demerara's signature smoky, toffee-rich flavor with intense strength (often ~151 proof). It's an essential component in powerful Tiki drinks, delivering deep caramel smoke and an extra kick, though used sparingly due to its potency.

items.name: Rhum Agricole Blanc
items.description: Unaged white rum distilled from fresh sugarcane juice and bottled straight off the still, keeping its full grassy, pungent character intact. Bursting with herbal and tropical fruit notes, it's traditional in the Ti' Punch and adds an unmistakable earthy kick to cocktails calling for raw sugarcane spirit.

items.name: Rhum Agricole Vieux
items.description: Aged rhum agricole ('vieux' meaning old) mellowed in oak barrels for years, which tames its grassy bite and adds vanilla, spice, and woody notes. The result is a refined spirit blending earthy cane character with Cognac-like smoothness, excellent for sipping or adding layered complexity to premium cocktails.

items.name: Blackstrap Rum
items.description: An extremely dark, heavy rum made from the final molasses (blackstrap) of sugar refining, loaded with deep molasses and licorice flavors. Thick and a bit bitter-sweet, it's usually used in small doses in cocktails to impart rich color and a robust treacle-like sweetness (for example, as a float in Tiki drinks).

items.name: Spiced Rum
items.description: Rum infused with spices (vanilla, cinnamon, clove, etc.) and often a hint of added sweetness. Its warming spice and smooth sweetness make it popular for mixing with cola, ginger beer, or in easy tropical drinks, though it's rarely called for in classic cocktails.

items.name: Tequila Blanco
items.description: Unaged tequila (often bottled right after distillation) for a vibrant, peppery agave character. Pure agave flavor; the go-to base for Margaritas, Palomas, and other tequila cocktails.

items.name: Tequila Reposado
items.description: 'Rested' tequila aged 2-12 months in oak, gaining a light golden hue with mellow vanilla and caramel notes. Balances fresh agave brightness with oak smoothness; adds a soft complexity to Margaritas and other cocktails.

items.name: Tequila Añejo
items.description: Tequila aged 1-3 years in small oak barrels; amber-colored with smooth, rich notes of vanilla, caramel, spice, and dried fruit. Often sipped neat for its complexity, but also a bold substitute for whiskey in Old Fashioned-style cocktails.

items.name: Tequila Extra Añejo
items.description: Ultra-aged tequila (minimum 3 years in oak); deep mahogany spirit with intensely layered oak, caramel, and spice flavors. Luxuriously smooth and complex—usually reserved for sipping like a fine cognac rather than used in mixed drinks.

items.name: Mezcal
items.description: Traditional Mexican agave spirit (from 40+ agave species), typically pit-roasted for a signature smoky, earthy flavor. Rustic and complex; brings smoky depth to Margaritas and other cocktails, or enjoyed neat for its rich, earthy character.

items.name: Mezcal Joven
items.description: Unaged mezcal ('joven' meaning young), bottled straight after distillation for a bold, authentic agave profile. Clear and intense, showcasing raw smoky agave; the standard mezcal style and ideal for cocktails requiring pure agave flavor.

items.name: Mezcal Espadín
items.description: Mezcal distilled from the Espadín agave (Angustifolia), the workhorse varietal behind up to 90% of all mezcal. Balanced smoke and gentle agave sweetness; an approachable, versatile choice that integrates smoothly into mezcal cocktails.

items.name: Mezcal (Other Agaves)
items.description: Artisanal mezcals made from wild or rare agave species (Tobalá, Tepeztate, Arroqueño, etc.), often slow-growing with limited yields. Expect bold, exotic flavors—from earthy and mineral to spicy and floral—reflecting each species' terroir. Usually sipped to appreciate their complexity, though a splash can add unique depth to cocktails.

items.name: Sotol
items.description: Earthy northern Mexican spirit distilled from the desert spoon plant (not a true agave), using mezcal-like roasting methods. Offers a smoky, earthy flavor with a bright, grassy twist; used as a unique herbal alternative to tequila or mezcal in cocktails.

items.name: Raicilla
items.description: Funky, rustic agave spirit from Jalisco (western Mexico), often dubbed 'Mexican moonshine' for its outlaw origins. More aromatic than tequila, with notes of wet earth, pepper, and tropical fruit—yet typically less smoky than mezcal; a daring swap for an adventurous agave cocktail.

items.name: Vodka
items.description: Neutral grain spirit; clean and crisp. Classic base for Martinis and highballs.

items.name: Citrus Vodka
items.description: Vodka infused with lemon or citrus peel. Bright and zesty; often used in sours and spritzes.

items.name: Vanilla Vodka
items.description: Flavored vodka with sweet vanilla notes. Adds warmth to creamy or dessert-style cocktails.

items.name: Pepper Vodka
items.description: Vodka infused with black or chili pepper. Spicy kick for Bloody Marys and savory drinks.

items.name: Potato Vodka
items.description: Vodka distilled from potatoes. Creamy texture with subtle earthy notes.

items.name: Wheat Vodka
items.description: Vodka made from wheat; smooth and soft. Common in crisp, balanced vodka cocktails.

items.name: Rye Vodka
items.description: Vodka distilled from rye grain. Dry and slightly spicy; good in bold builds.

items.name: Cognac
items.description: French brandy from the Cognac region. Smooth, elegant; used in Sidecars and sips.

items.name: Armagnac
items.description: Rustic French brandy from Gascony. Earthier and bolder than Cognac; often sipped.

items.name: Calvados
items.description: Apple brandy from Normandy, France. Fruity and dry; works in fall cocktails or sipped neat.

items.name: Pisco
items.description: Unaged grape brandy from Peru or Chile. Floral and bright; base of the Pisco Sour.

items.name: Grappa
items.description: Italian pomace brandy from grape skins. Sharp and herbal; mostly sipped, sometimes mixed.

items.name: VS Brandy
items.description: 'Very Special' — aged at least 2 years. Lightest style; ideal for mixed drinks.

items.name: VSOP Brandy
items.description: 'Very Superior Old Pale' — aged 4+ years. Smoother and richer; bridges sipping and mixing.

items.name: Eau de Vie
items.description: Clear, unaged fruit brandy. Pure fruit flavor; used in delicate cocktails.

items.name: American Brandy
items.description: Domestic brandy, often grape-based. Versatile style; mixes well or sips neat.

items.name: Spanish Brandy
items.description: Brandy from Spain, often sherry cask-aged. Rich, nutty, and smooth; good neat or stirred.

items.name: Applejack
items.description: American apple brandy or blend. Rustic fruit notes; stars in a Jack Rose.

items.name: Marc
items.description: French pomace brandy (like grappa). Rustic and dry; rarely mixed, often sipped.

items.name: Absinthe
items.description: High-proof anise spirit with wormwood. Used in dashes or rinses; classic in Sazeracs.

items.name: Aquavit
items.description: Scandinavian spirit flavored with caraway and dill. Savory and herbal; used in Nordic-inspired cocktails.

items.name: Aguardiente
items.description: Latin American anise-flavored spirit. Strong and sweet; typically shot or sipped.

items.name: Baijiu
items.description: Chinese grain spirit with complex, funky flavors. Traditionally sipped; emerging in cocktails.

items.name: Soju
items.description: Korean spirit, mild and slightly sweet. Low proof; popular for casual drinking and simple mixes.

items.name: Shochu
items.description: Japanese distilled spirit from rice, barley, or sweet potato. Clean and versatile; mixed or on the rocks.

items.name: Pastis
items.description: French anise-flavored aperitif. Turns cloudy with water; refreshing and licorice-forward.

items.name: Sambuca
items.description: Italian anise liqueur, sweet and aromatic. Often served with coffee beans or as a shot.

items.name: Cointreau
items.description: Clear triple sec-style orange liqueur. Bright, balanced; essential in Margaritas and Cosmos.

items.name: Grand Marnier
items.description: Orange liqueur blended with Cognac. Richer, deeper flavor; used in Sidecars and sips.

items.name: Triple Sec
items.description: Sweet, neutral orange liqueur. Affordable option for citrus-forward cocktails.

items.name: Orange Curaçao
items.description: Dutch-style orange liqueur, often sweeter. Classic in Mai Tais and tiki recipes.

items.name: Blue Curaçao
items.description: Artificially colored orange liqueur. Tropical visual flair; similar flavor to triple sec.

items.name: Dry Curaçao
items.description: Orange liqueur with drier, spiced profile. Elegant citrus note in classics and riffs.

items.name: Green Chartreuse
items.description: Potent herbal liqueur made by Carthusian monks. Intensely complex; key in Last Words and Bijous.

items.name: Yellow Chartreuse
items.description: Milder, sweeter sibling to Green Chartreuse. Floral and spiced; used in softer riffs and sips.

items.name: Bénédictine
items.description: French herbal liqueur with honey and spice. Smooth and warming; in classics like the Vieux Carré.

items.name: Galliano
items.description: Tall, vanilla-forward Italian herbal liqueur. Used in Harvey Wallbangers and dessert drinks.

items.name: Strega
items.description: Saffron-tinted Italian liqueur; herbal and aniseed. Sweet and spiced; used in unique stirred builds.

items.name: Génépy
items.description: Alpine herbal liqueur related to Chartreuse. Light, floral bitterness; adds alpine lift to cocktails.

items.name: Becherovka
items.description: Czech herbal bitters with cinnamon and clove. Spicy and warming; sipped or mixed like amaro.

items.name: Jägermeister
items.description: German herbal liqueur; sweet, dark, and spiced. Used in shots or to add depth to modern drinks.

items.name: Absinthe Verte
items.description: High-proof anise liqueur with wormwood. Used in dashes or rinses; classic in Sazeracs.

items.name: Ancho Chile Liqueur
items.description: Mexican chile liqueur made from dried poblanos. Smoky heat; adds depth to spicy or savory drinks.

items.name: Zirbenz Stone Pine Liqueur
items.description: Stone pine liqueur from the Alps. Forest-y and resinous; great in wintery riffs.

items.name: Kümmel
items.description: Caraway, cumin, and fennel-flavored liqueur. Savory and spiced; appears in vintage classics.

items.name: Campari
items.description: Bright red Italian bitter with herbal and citrus notes. Defines Negronis and Americanos.

items.name: Aperol
items.description: Low-proof Italian aperitivo; orange and rhubarb. Lighter and sweeter than Campari; key in Spritzes.

items.name: Fernet Branca
items.description: Bold, bitter amaro with mint and herbal intensity. Sipped, shot, or mixed in rich stirred drinks.

items.name: Amaro Nonino
items.description: Elegant amaro with citrus peel and soft spice. Core of the Paper Plane; bittersweet and smooth.

items.name: Amaro Montenegro
items.description: Gentle amaro with orange blossom and vanilla. Approachable; used in low-ABV builds or sipped.

items.name: Amaro Averna
items.description: Dark, syrupy Sicilian amaro. Rich with cola and spice; great in Black Manhattans.

items.name: Cynar
items.description: Artichoke-based amaro with vegetal bitterness. Earthy and herbal; used in spritzes and Negroni riffs.

items.name: Amaro Lucano
items.description: Medium-weight amaro with citrus and baking spice. Balanced and versatile in both sips and mixes.

items.name: Amaro Meletti
items.description: Sweet-forward amaro with floral and cola notes. Great after dinner or in mellow stirred cocktails.

items.name: Amer Picon
items.description: Bitter French orange liqueur with gentian. Traditional in the Picon Bière and Brooklyn.

items.name: Suze
items.description: Pale yellow gentian liqueur; earthy and bitter. Bright bitterness for French aperitifs and highballs.

items.name: Select Aperitivo
items.description: Venetian aperitivo with bitter orange and herbs. Campari alternative; core of the original Spritz.

items.name: Cynar 70
items.description: High-proof version of Cynar. Bolder bitterness; stands up in boozier builds.

items.name: Fernet Menta
items.description: Fernet Branca with added mint and sweetness. Cooling and bold; used in shots or chocolatey drinks.

items.name: Amaro Ramazzotti
items.description: Balanced, cola-like amaro from Milan. Smooth and round; friendly in simple stirred drinks.

items.name: Amaro Nardini
items.description: Dry, alpine-style amaro with licorice and herbs. Lean and bitter; used in complex stirred drinks.

items.name: Amaro Braulio
items.description: Mountain amaro from the Italian Alps. Dry, piney, and herbal; great after dinner.

items.name: Amaro Dell'Etna
items.description: Sicilian amaro with baking spice and citrus. Bold and bittersweet; versatile in bitter builds.

items.name: Amaro Sibilla
items.description: Rustic, intense amaro with honey and bitter roots. Dense and earthy; more for sipping than mixing.

items.name: Amaro Tosolini
items.description: Modern amaro with orange peel and cocoa. Smooth and rounded; great neat or in a flip.

items.name: Amaro Zucca
items.description: Rhubarb-based amaro with smoky, herbal notes. Lighter body; used in aperitivo-style cocktails.

items.name: Cardamaro
items.description: Wine-based amaro with cardoon and blessed thistle. Bittersweet and soft; pairs well with whiskey.

items.name: Bonal Gentiane-Quina
items.description: Aromatized wine with gentian and quinine. Floral and bitter; great in aperitif-style drinks.

items.name: Cappelletti Aperitivo
items.description: Red bitter liqueur made with wine base. Lighter than Campari; smooth in spritzes.

items.name: Contratto Bitter
items.description: All-natural red bitter liqueur from Italy. Vibrant and herbal; high-end Campari substitute.

items.name: Italicus
items.description: Rosolio made with bergamot and florals. Bright, elegant citrus; modern aperitivo.

items.name: China-China
items.description: Rich, dark French amaro with orange and spice. Thick and bittersweet; used in spirit-forward builds.

items.name: Pelinkovac
items.description: Balkan wormwood-based bitter liqueur. Intensely herbal and dry; often sipped or shot.

items.name: Byrrh
items.description: Red wine quinquina with fruit and spice. Low-proof and earthy; used like sweet vermouth.

items.name: Select Bitter
items.description: Venetian aperitivo used in original Spritz. Alternative name for Select Aperitivo.

items.name: Luxardo Bitter Bianco
items.description: A clear, white bitter aperitivo from Luxardo with flavors of wormwood, citrus peel, and alpine herbs. Crisp and bracingly bitter with floral and herbal complexity; a striking substitute for Campari in white or colorless Negroni-style cocktails.

items.name: Amaretto
items.description: Almond-flavored liqueur, often from apricot pits. Sweet and nutty; used in Sours and dessert drinks.

items.name: Frangelico
items.description: Italian hazelnut liqueur with hints of vanilla. Rich and smooth; common in creamy builds.

items.name: Nocino
items.description: Dark walnut liqueur from green walnuts. Bittersweet and spiced; used in fall/winter cocktails.

items.name: Hazelnut Liqueur
items.description: Sweet, roasted hazelnut-flavored liqueur. Lighter than Frangelico; pairs well with chocolate.

items.name: Walnut Liqueur
items.description: Nutty, tannic liqueur made from green walnuts. Similar to nocino; earthy and complex.

items.name: Pistachio Liqueur
items.description: Creamy liqueur with pistachio flavor. Rare; used in dessert-style or novelty builds.

items.name: Maraschino Liqueur
items.description: Clear cherry liqueur with nutty, dry finish. Essential in classics like the Aviation and Last Word.

items.name: Crème de Cassis
items.description: Sweet blackcurrant liqueur from France. Used in Kir or to add berry depth to cocktails.

items.name: Crème de Mûre
items.description: Blackberry liqueur; rich and sweet. Stars in the Bramble and other berry builds.

items.name: Chambord
items.description: French black raspberry liqueur with vanilla. Elegant and sweet; used in sours and bubbles.

items.name: Cherry Heering
items.description: Danish cherry liqueur with spice and depth. Key in the Singapore Sling; darker than maraschino.

items.name: Kirsch
items.description: Dry, clear cherry brandy (eau de vie). Not sweet; used in punches or alpine drinks.

items.name: Apricot Brandy
items.description: Apricot liqueur or brandy base with stone fruit flavor. Adds fruity warmth to classics and tiki.

items.name: Peach Schnapps
items.description: Intensely sweet, low-proof peach liqueur. Used in 80s/90s drinks like the Sex on the Beach.

items.name: Passoa
items.description: Bright red passion fruit liqueur from France. Tropical and tart; used in Pornstar Martinis.

items.name: Midori
items.description: Neon green Japanese melon liqueur. Sweet and fruity; iconic in 80s/90s cocktails.

items.name: Limoncello
items.description: Italian lemon liqueur; sweet and citrusy. Typically served chilled; also used in sours.

items.name: Poire William
items.description: Pear eau de vie; dry and aromatic. Used in elegant stirred or Champagne cocktails.

items.name: Peach Liqueur
items.description: Sweeter peach option; often labeled crème de pêche. Lighter alternative to schnapps in classic builds.

items.name: Pear Liqueur
items.description: Sweetened liqueur with ripe pear flavor. Soft and floral; pairs well with gin or whiskey.

items.name: Raspberry Liqueur
items.description: Bright red and sweet; ripe berry character. Used in Clover Clubs or sparkling drinks.

items.name: Blackberry Liqueur
items.description: Deep, jammy liqueur with ripe berry notes. Used in Brambles, cobblers, and fruity riffs.

items.name: Strawberry Liqueur
items.description: Sweet and red-fruited; often syrupy. Used in dessert-style or novelty cocktails.

items.name: Banana Liqueur
items.description: Bright yellow liqueur with ripe banana flavor. Classic in tiki and tropical builds.

items.name: Passion Fruit Liqueur
items.description: Tart and tropical with citrusy acidity. Adds zing to modern sours and spritzes.

items.name: Blood Orange Liqueur
items.description: Rich, slightly bitter orange liqueur. Deeper than triple sec; great in riffs.

items.name: Lemon Liqueur
items.description: Sweet lemon liqueur, similar to limoncello. Used in citrus-forward or dessert drinks.

items.name: Lime Liqueur
items.description: Zesty, sweet-tart lime flavor. Rarely used alone; supports tropical builds.

items.name: Apricot Liqueur
items.description: Stone fruit liqueur; sweet and jammy. Richer and more syrupy than apricot brandy.

items.name: Crème de Cacao (Dark)
items.description: Rich, sweet chocolate liqueur with dark cocoa flavor. Used in dessert cocktails and classics like the Alexander.

items.name: Crème de Cacao (White)
items.description: Clear version of chocolate liqueur. Same flavor as dark; keeps drinks light in color.

items.name: Crème de Menthe (Green)
items.description: Bright green mint liqueur; sweet and cooling. Used in Grasshoppers and vintage drinks.

items.name: Crème de Menthe (White)
items.description: Clear mint liqueur; same flavor as green. Keeps color neutral in cocktails.

items.name: Baileys Irish Cream
items.description: Cream liqueur with Irish whiskey and chocolate. Popular in coffee drinks and dessert-style cocktails.

items.name: Mozart Chocolate Liqueur
items.description: Austrian liqueur line focused on chocolate. Creamy and rich; used in decadent drinks.

items.name: Coffee Liqueur
items.description: Sweet coffee-flavored liqueur; often rum-based. Classic in Espresso Martinis and White Russians.

items.name: Tia Maria
items.description: Jamaican coffee liqueur with vanilla notes. Lighter than Kahlúa; great in iced or creamy builds.

items.name: Mr Black
items.description: Australian cold brew coffee liqueur. Less sweet, more robust; a modern favorite.

items.name: Espresso Liqueur
items.description: Concentrated coffee liqueur with bold espresso flavor. Intense; for coffee-forward cocktails.

items.name: Elderflower Liqueur
items.description: Delicate liqueur with floral and lychee notes. Best known in the St-Germain Spritz.

items.name: Crème de Violette
items.description: Sweet violet liqueur; floral and perfumed. Core of the Aviation cocktail.

items.name: Parfait Amour
items.description: Floral liqueur with citrus and vanilla. Purple-hued; used in vintage and novelty drinks.

items.name: Crème Yvette
items.description: Violet-based liqueur with berries and spice. Richer than violette; also used in Aviations.

items.name: Rose Liqueur
items.description: Fragrant liqueur with sweet rose flavor. Used sparingly to add floral nuance.

items.name: Lavender Liqueur
items.description: Herbal-floral liqueur with bright lavender notes. Pairs well with gin, honey, or citrus.

items.name: Orange Blossom Liqueur
items.description: Floral citrus liqueur from orange tree blossoms. Delicate and aromatic; ideal for perfumed builds.

items.name: Drambuie
items.description: Scotch-based liqueur with honey and herbs. Key in the Rusty Nail; rich and smooth.

items.name: Falernum
items.description: Caribbean liqueur with lime, almond, and spice. Tiki essential; used in Mai Tais and Zombies.

items.name: Allspice Dram
items.description: Pimento berry liqueur; warm and spiced. Adds depth to tiki and winter cocktails.

items.name: Licor 43
items.description: Vanilla and citrus Spanish liqueur. Used in coffee drinks and creamy builds.

items.name: Domaine de Canton
items.description: Ginger liqueur with honey and citrus. Bright and spicy; pairs well with whiskey or rum.

items.name: Ancho Reyes
items.description: Smoky chile liqueur made from ancho chiles. Adds heat and depth to bold cocktails.

items.name: Velvet Falernum
items.description: Bottled falernum liqueur; softer and sweet. Classic in tiki and Caribbean drinks.

items.name: Sloe Liqueur
items.description: Sweet liqueur made from sloe berries. Fruitier than sloe gin; used in spritzes and fizzes.

items.name: Anisette
items.description: Sweet anise-flavored liqueur. Used in Mediterranean and old-school builds.

items.name: Pimento Dram
items.description: Another name for Allspice Dram. Spiced and warming; key in tropical spice notes.

items.name: Sweet Vermouth
items.description: Red vermouth with herbal, spiced sweetness. Core of Manhattans and Negronis.

items.name: Dry Vermouth
items.description: Pale, dry fortified wine with herbal notes. Essential in Martinis and lighter stirred drinks.

items.name: Blanc Vermouth
items.description: White vermouth; sweeter than dry, lighter than red. Floral and citrusy; great in aperitifs and spritzes.

items.name: Punt e Mes
items.description: Bitter Italian vermouth with a dark, spicy profile. Bolder than standard sweet vermouth.

items.name: Rosé Vermouth
items.description: Rosé-based vermouth; light and floral. Delicate aperitif; often served with soda or tonic.

items.name: Lillet Blanc
items.description: French aperitif wine with citrus and floral notes. Used in Vespers and light spritzes.

items.name: Lillet Rosé
items.description: Rosé-based version of Lillet. Fruity and refreshing; great with tonic.

items.name: Lillet Rouge
items.description: Red wine aperitif with spice and berry notes. Richer than Blanc; sipped or used in low-ABV builds.

items.name: Cocchi Americano
items.description: Bittered white aperitif wine with gentian. Lillet Blanc alternative; crisp and complex.

items.name: Cocchi Rosa
items.description: Rosé aperitif wine with fruit and spice. Bittersweet and vibrant; ideal in spritzes.

items.name: Dubonnet
items.description: Sweet red quinquina with spice and fruit. Favored in classic aperitif cocktails.

items.name: Pineau des Charentes
items.description: French fortified wine with Cognac and grape juice. Sweet and nutty; usually sipped chilled.

items.name: Dubonnet Rouge
items.description: Red Dubonnet; rich and spiced. Used in aperitifs and classic French cocktails.

items.name: Dubonnet Blanc
items.description: White Dubonnet; lighter and herbal. A softer take on the rouge; aperitif-style.

items.name: Byrrh (Quinquina)
items.description: Red wine-based quinquina with quinine and herbs. Bittersweet and earthy; served chilled or mixed.

items.name: Bonal Gentiane-Quina
items.description: Aromatized wine with gentian and quinine. Bitter and herbal; bridges vermouth and amaro.

items.name: Fino Sherry
items.description: Dry, pale sherry with salty, almondy character. Great in lighter aperitif-style cocktails.

items.name: Manzanilla Sherry
items.description: Fino-style from Sanlúcar; slightly brinier. Crisp and delicate; ideal in coastal or savory builds.

items.name: Amontillado Sherry
items.description: Medium-dry sherry; nutty with oxidative notes. Adds depth to stirred and savory cocktails.

items.name: Oloroso Sherry
items.description: Rich, dark, and dry sherry with bold flavor. Used in heavier stirred or whiskey-based drinks.

items.name: Pedro Ximénez Sherry
items.description: Extremely sweet, raisiny dessert sherry. Used in dessert drinks or small touches for richness.

items.name: Cream Sherry
items.description: Blended sweet sherry; soft and smooth. Used in flips or dessert-style builds.

items.name: Palo Cortado Sherry
items.description: Rare style; combines finesse of Amontillado with body of Oloroso. Dry and complex; used in high-end stirred builds.

items.name: Ruby Port
items.description: Young, sweet red port; bright fruit flavor. Used in punches or rich, fruity cocktails.

items.name: Tawny Port
items.description: Aged port with nutty, oxidative character. Smooth and mellow; used in stirred or dessert drinks.

items.name: White Port
items.description: Made from white grapes; lightly sweet and crisp. Used in spritzes or Port & Tonics.

items.name: Madeira
items.description: Fortified wine from Portugal; tangy and oxidized. Complex and long-lasting; great in flips and sours.

items.name: Marsala (Dry)
items.description: Sicilian fortified wine with nutty dryness. Used in savory cocktails or culinary riffs.

items.name: Marsala (Sweet)
items.description: Sweet version of Marsala; raisiny and rich. Occasionally used in dessert-style cocktails.

items.name: Champagne
items.description: French sparkling wine from Champagne region. Dry, toasty, and crisp; used in classic bubbly cocktails.

items.name: Prosecco
items.description: Italian sparkling wine; fruitier and softer than Champagne. Popular in Spritzes and light brunch drinks.

items.name: Cava
items.description: Spanish sparkling wine; dry and zesty. Affordable alternative to Champagne in cocktails.

items.name: Sparkling Wine
items.description: General term for carbonated wines. Adds effervescence to spritzes and festive builds.

items.name: Sparkling Rosé
items.description: Rosé-based sparkling wine. Bright, fruity, and pink; used in vibrant cocktails.

items.name: Dry White Wine
items.description: Crisp white wine with little to no residual sugar. Used in spritzes or cooking-style builds.

items.name: Red Wine
items.description: Varied in body and flavor; tannic and bold. Floated on drinks or used in punches and sangrias.

items.name: Rosé Wine
items.description: Light pink wine with floral and berry notes. Served chilled; sometimes used in spritz or sangria riffs.

items.name: Angostura Bitters
items.description: Classic aromatic bitters from Trinidad. Spiced and herbal; foundational in countless classics.

items.name: Peychaud's Bitters
items.description: Bright red bitters with anise and floral notes. Signature of the Sazerac cocktail.

items.name: Orange Bitters
items.description: Bitters with orange peel and spice. Brightens up Martinis and whiskey drinks.

items.name: Chocolate Bitters
items.description: Bitters with dark cocoa notes. Used in dessert-style and aged-spirit cocktails.

items.name: Celery Bitters
items.description: Savory bitters with herbal vegetal character. Adds depth to savory or Bloody Mary-style drinks.

items.name: Aromatic Bitters
items.description: Catchall for spiced, herbal bitters. Used in spirit-forward classics and riffs.

items.name: Grapefruit Bitters
items.description: Bright and zesty bitters with grapefruit peel. Adds citrus lift to tropical and gin drinks.

items.name: Lavender Bitters
items.description: Floral bitters with light herbal notes. Great in gin and vodka cocktails.

items.name: Mole Bitters
items.description: Mexican spice and cocoa profile. Used in tequila or whiskey cocktails.

items.name: Cherry Bitters
items.description: Bitters with cherry and spice notes. Subtle fruit lift for stirred or aged builds.

items.name: Lemon Bitters
items.description: Bright lemon-peel bitters. Used to sharpen citrus-forward drinks.

items.name: Coffee Bitters
items.description: Bitter with roasted coffee notes. Pairs with dark spirits or creamy builds.

items.name: Cardamom Bitters
items.description: Spiced bitters with warm, herbal depth. Used in exotic or seasonal cocktails.

items.name: Cherry Bark Bitters
items.description: Bitters made with cherry bark and spice. Adds woodsy complexity to whiskey drinks.

items.name: Club Soda
items.description: Carbonated water with added minerals for texture. Neutral flavor; adds lift without sweetness — key in highballs and spirit-forward spritzes.

items.name: Tonic Water
items.description: Bitter-sweet soda flavored with quinine and citrus. Essential in G&Ts; enhances botanical or dry spirits with bite and brightness.

items.name: Ginger Beer
items.description: Bold, spicy soda made from ginger root and sugar. Used in Mules and tropical builds to add warmth, kick, and body.

items.name: Ginger Ale
items.description: Milder, sweeter ginger soda. Softer than ginger beer; common in highballs and easy mixes.

items.name: Cola
items.description: Sweet, caramelized soda with spice notes. Classic mixer for rum, whiskey, and simple highballs.

items.name: Lemon-Lime Soda
items.description: Sweet citrus soda with lemon and lime flavors. Used in casual mixed drinks and punches.

items.name: Sparkling Mineral Water
items.description: Naturally carbonated water with mineral content. Adds subtle complexity to highballs and spritzes.

items.name: Lemon Juice
items.description: Tart, high-acid citrus juice with clean sharpness. Used in sours, fizzes, and shaken builds to cut sweetness and add structure.

items.name: Lime Juice
items.description: Zesty and sharper than lemon; drier acidity. Backbone of Margarita, Daiquiri, and tiki formulas; often paired with rum or agave.

items.name: Orange Juice
items.description: Sweet, mild citrus juice with low acidity. Used in brunch drinks and simple mixers.

items.name: Grapefruit Juice
items.description: Tart and slightly bitter citrus juice. Adds bright, refreshing acidity to cocktails like the Paloma.

items.name: Pineapple Juice
items.description: Sweet, fruity juice with natural froth and tropical depth. Common in shaken and tiki drinks for both flavor and mouthfeel.

items.name: Cranberry Juice
items.description: Tart, ruby-red juice with astringent finish. Used in Cosmopolitans and vodka mixers.

items.name: Tomato Juice
items.description: Savory, thick juice from tomatoes. Base of Bloody Marys and savory cocktails.

items.name: Apple Juice
items.description: Sweet, mild fruit juice. Used in fall cocktails and punches.

items.name: Passion Fruit Purée
items.description: Thick, intensely tropical fruit purée. Adds bold flavor and texture to sours and tiki drinks.

items.name: Peach Purée
items.description: Smooth stone fruit purée. Classic in Bellinis and summer cocktails.

items.name: Pomegranate Juice
items.description: Deep red juice with tart, fruity flavor. Adds color and depth to punches and modern cocktails.

items.name: Coconut Water
items.description: Light, slightly sweet water from coconuts. Refreshing base for tropical and hydrating drinks.

items.name: Heavy Cream
items.description: High-fat dairy that adds richness and weight. Used in dessert-style drinks like the Brandy Alexander or White Russian for body and texture.

items.name: Half & Half
items.description: Blend of milk and cream. Lighter than heavy cream; used in creamy cocktails and coffee drinks.

items.name: Whole Milk
items.description: Full-fat milk with mild richness. Used in flips, nogs, and coffee cocktails.

items.name: Coconut Cream
items.description: Thick, sweet extract of coconut flesh. Key to Piña Coladas; lends tropical richness and creamy texture with subtle coconut flavor.

items.name: Coconut Milk
items.description: Thinner than coconut cream; mild coconut flavor. Used in tropical and dairy-free builds.

items.name: Oat Milk
items.description: Non-dairy milk with mild sweetness and creamy consistency. Popular vegan substitute in coffee and dessert drinks; plays well with spice and spirits.

items.name: Egg White
items.description: Used for silky texture and foam in shaken drinks. Adds body and visual flair without flavor; core of Sours and Fizzes.

items.name: Egg Yolk
items.description: Rich, fatty component used in flips and nogs. Contributes luxurious texture and depth; pairs well with spice and aged spirits.

items.name: Whole Egg
items.description: Combines yolk and white for full, creamy effect. Classic in flips and dessert drinks; adds weight and froth in one.

items.name: Aquafaba
items.description: Vegan alternative to egg white made from chickpea brine. Replicates foam and texture without flavor or allergens.

items.name: Simple Syrup
items.description: 1:1 sugar-to-water syrup; neutral sweetener. Used in nearly every shaken or stirred build.

items.name: Rich Simple Syrup
items.description: 2:1 sugar-to-water syrup; thicker and more stable. Adds more weight and longevity; often used in bars.

items.name: Demerara Syrup
items.description: Syrup made from raw demerara sugar. Richer and more molasses-like; common in tiki and whiskey drinks.

items.name: Honey Syrup
items.description: Diluted honey (usually 2:1 or 3:1 with water). Adds floral sweetness; easier to mix than raw honey.

items.name: Honey-Ginger Syrup
items.description: Honey syrup infused with fresh ginger. Spicy and bright; used in seasonal and bourbon-based builds.

items.name: Agave Syrup
items.description: Sweetener made from blue agave plant. Earthy and mild; pairs naturally with tequila and mezcal.

items.name: Maple Syrup
items.description: Unrefined sap-based syrup; sweet and earthy. Used in fall cocktails and whiskey builds for depth.

items.name: Orgeat
items.description: Almond syrup with orange blossom water. Milky and aromatic; essential in Mai Tais and tiki.

items.name: Grenadine
items.description: Pomegranate syrup (often artificially flavored). Adds red color and tart-sweet fruit; common in classics.

items.name: Raspberry Syrup
items.description: Bright berry syrup with tart sweetness. Used in Clover Clubs and other shaken builds.

items.name: Passion Fruit Syrup
items.description: Tart tropical syrup with vivid acidity. Stars in tiki and sour-style cocktails.

items.name: Ginger Syrup
items.description: Spicy syrup from fresh ginger and sugar. Used in Mules and to add kick to citrus drinks.

items.name: Cinnamon Syrup
items.description: Warm, spiced syrup used in fall/winter builds. Pairs well with whiskey, rum, and apple flavors.

items.name: Vanilla Syrup
items.description: Sweet syrup flavored with vanilla bean. Used in dessert drinks, coffee builds, or to round bitterness.

items.name: Lavender Syrup
items.description: Floral syrup with soft herbal aroma. Used in gin, vodka, or Champagne cocktails.

items.name: Chamomile Cordial
items.description: Tea-based syrup with floral and apple-like notes. Delicate and mellow; used in lighter seasonal builds.

items.name: Turbinado Syrup
items.description: Syrup made from coarse raw sugar. Similar to demerara; adds rustic sweetness and body.

items.name: White Sugar
items.description: Refined cane sugar; standard sweetener. Used in syrups or muddled in Old Fashioneds.

items.name: Sugar Cube
items.description: Pressed white sugar; used in Champagne and stirred builds. Crushed with bitters in traditional cocktails.

items.name: Brown Sugar
items.description: Moist sugar with molasses content. Adds richness to fall and dark spirit builds.

items.name: Demerara Sugar
items.description: Coarse raw sugar with toffee flavor. Used in muddles or syrup for tiki and whiskey drinks.

items.name: Raw Honey
items.description: Unprocessed honey; floral and intense. Used in syrups or directly when warmed; complements citrus and whiskey.

items.name: Powdered Sugar
items.description: Finely milled sugar with cornstarch. Rare in cocktails; sometimes used for dusting or foam stabilization.

items.name: Lemon
items.description: Bright yellow citrus with high acidity and floral zest. Used for juice, peels, and twists in sours, highballs, and garnish.

items.name: Lime
items.description: Smaller, sharper cousin to lemon with tropical tang. Essential in tiki and Latin spirits; used for juice and zest.

items.name: Orange
items.description: Sweet and aromatic with low acidity. Used as juice, peel, or twist; common garnish in stirred and sparkling drinks.

items.name: Grapefruit
items.description: Large citrus with tart, bitter-sweet juice. Used for bold juice builds or zesty garnishes; pairs well with tequila and gin.

items.name: Blood Orange
items.description: Dark-fleshed orange with berry undertones. Adds color and richness; used in seasonal or citrus-forward riffs.

items.name: Yuzu
items.description: Small Japanese citrus with intense floral aroma. Used sparingly for exotic citrus brightness; great in spritzes or riffs.

items.name: Mint
items.description: Bright, cooling herb used in muddled or garnished form. Essential in Juleps and Mojitos; aromatically lifts citrus and crushed ice drinks.

items.name: Basil
items.description: Sweet, peppery herb often paired with strawberry, tomato, or citrus. Adds savory complexity and garden freshness to modern builds.

items.name: Rosemary
items.description: Piney, assertive herb with woody aroma. Used as a smoked or flame-kissed garnish; pairs well with gin, citrus, and savory notes.

items.name: Thyme
items.description: Delicate, earthy herb with citrusy undertone. Used in infused syrups or as garnish; complements stone fruit and gin.

items.name: Sage
items.description: Soft, savory leaf with subtle bitterness. Works in fall or whiskey drinks; best paired with apple, brown spirits, or maple.

items.name: Cilantro
items.description: Bright and polarizing herb; grassy and sharp. Rare but striking in tequila and tropical drinks; often muddled or infused.

items.name: Dill
items.description: Fragrant, herbal green with vegetal snap. Used sparingly in savory builds; complements aquavit, cucumber, or tomato.

items.name: Strawberry
items.description: Sweet, soft berry; muddled or puréed in drinks. Pairs beautifully with balsamic, basil, or sparkling wine.

items.name: Raspberry
items.description: Tart and fragrant; used whole or as syrup. Punchy flavor that brightens sours or Champagne drinks.

items.name: Blackberry
items.description: Deep, jammy berry with rich sweetness. Common in Brambles and fall-style cocktails; muddled or puréed.

items.name: Blueberry
items.description: Mildly sweet with gentle acidity. Often muddled or cooked into syrup; pairs well with lemon or gin.

items.name: Cucumber
items.description: Cool, clean, and crisp; usually muddled or sliced. Adds refreshing snap; ideal with gin, vodka, or Pimm's.

items.name: Watermelon
items.description: Juicy and sweet with subtle vegetal notes. Blended or juiced for summer drinks; mixes well with lime or mint.

items.name: Fresh Pineapple
items.description: Fibrous and intensely tropical; juiced or muddled. Adds texture, foam, and tang; tiki essential.

items.name: Banana
items.description: Soft, starchy fruit; usually puréed or used in syrup. Brings creamy body and tropical weight to tiki or dessert builds.

items.name: Apple
items.description: Crisp and tart to sweet depending on type. Juiced, muddled, or sliced; works with whiskey, brandy, or spice.

items.name: Pear
items.description: Soft, floral fruit with mellow sweetness. Used in purées or garnishes; complements gin, sparkling wine, and amari.

items.name: Fig
items.description: Rich, jammy, and subtly earthy. Used in syrups or muddles; adds depth to fall and whiskey builds.

items.name: Passion Fruit
items.description: Tart, tropical fruit with bright aroma and seedy pulp. Used as purée or syrup; lifts sours and tiki drinks with high-tone acidity.

items.name: Jalapeño
items.description: Medium-heat green chili with grassy, fresh bite. Muddled or infused to add spice to tequila or mezcal builds.

items.name: Red Chili
items.description: Hotter than jalapeño, with sharper heat and color. Used sparingly in syrups or infusions for bold spicy contrast.

items.name: Habanero
items.description: High-heat pepper with fruity, floral character. Used in tinctures or small dashes; pairs well with tropical fruit and agave.

items.name: Fresh Ginger
items.description: Pungent root with heat and brightness. Muddled, juiced, or steeped; brings zip to sours, mules, and tea-based drinks.

items.name: Celery
items.description: Crisp, vegetal stalk with subtle salinity. Used in Bloody Marys and savory builds; adds crunch and herbal lift.

items.name: Horseradish
items.description: Spicy root with sinus-clearing heat. Used in small amounts for Bloody Marys or clarified savory cocktails.

items.name: Worcestershire Sauce
items.description: Umami-rich fermented sauce with anchovy and spice. Core Bloody Mary ingredient; adds savory depth and complexity.

items.name: Tabasco
items.description: Vinegary red chili hot sauce with sharp heat. Used to spike savory or spicy cocktails like Micheladas and Bloody Marys.

items.name: Sriracha
items.description: Thicker chili-garlic sauce with a hint of sweetness. Used in modern spicy builds; balances heat and flavor.

items.name: Salt
items.description: Universal flavor enhancer; intensifies and balances. Used in rims, infusions, or small pinches to brighten flavors.

items.name: Black Pepper
items.description: Pungent, earthy spice used ground or in tincture. Adds warmth and structure to savory or spice-driven builds.

items.name: Celery Salt
items.description: Savory, aromatic salt blend. Classic in Bloody Mary rims; adds vegetal umami.

items.name: Nutmeg
items.description: Warm, sweet spice often grated fresh. Used in flips, nogs, and dessert drinks; best when freshly grated over the top.

items.name: Cinnamon
items.description: Sweet, woody spice; used ground or as stick garnish. Adds warmth to fall and winter cocktails or tiki builds.

items.name: Cayenne Pepper
items.description: Hot red chili powder with quick, clean heat. Used to rim glasses or add kick to savory or tropical drinks.

items.name: Brine
items.description: Pickling liquid from olives or vegetables. Adds salt, acidity, and umami; key in Dirty Martinis and picklebacks.

items.name: Cocktail Cherry
items.description: Syrupy preserved cherry; often Luxardo or maraschino. Adds richness and visual polish; classic in Manhattans and Old Fashioneds.

items.name: Olives
items.description: Briny, oily garnish—typically green or stuffed. Essential in Martinis; adds savory note and visual weight.

items.name: Cocktail Onion
items.description: Sweet-sour pearl onion in brine. Defines the Gibson cocktail; adds vegetal salinity.

items.name: Pickled Vegetables
items.description: Assorted brined veg—okra, beans, carrots, etc. Savory garnish for Bloody Marys or brunch drinks.

items.name: Candied Ginger
items.description: Sugar-coated preserved ginger slices. Adds spicy-sweet bite to tropical, tea, or whiskey builds.

items.name: Coffee Beans
items.description: Whole roasted beans used as garnish. Floated on creamy or espresso drinks for aroma and visual cue.

items.name: Cocoa Powder
items.description: Finely ground chocolate powder, unsweetened. Dusted on dessert drinks for aroma and garnish.

items.name: Edible Flowers
items.description: Petals or whole blooms safe for consumption. Used for visual flair; complements light, floral, or gin-based builds.

items.name: Dehydrated Citrus
items.description: Dried citrus wheels or slices. Adds color and long-lasting aroma; used in modern garnish-forward builds.

items.name: Espresso
items.description: Strong, concentrated coffee brewed under pressure. Used in Espresso Martinis and bold, bitter-sweet builds.

items.name: Hot Coffee
items.description: Fresh-brewed drip or pour-over coffee. Adds warmth, roast, and richness to hot cocktails like Irish Coffee.

items.name: Cold Brew Coffee
items.description: Slow-steeped coffee; smooth and low in acidity. Used in chilled builds for mild bitterness and body.

items.name: Black Tea
items.description: Bold, tannic tea from oxidized leaves. Used in punches or syrup infusions; pairs well with citrus and spice.

items.name: Green Tea
items.description: Fresh, grassy tea with light bitterness. Used in lighter, floral cocktails or infused syrups.

items.name: Chamomile Tea
items.description: Mild herbal tea with floral, apple-like notes. Calming and aromatic; often used in hot or gin-based drinks.

items.name: Earl Grey Tea
items.description: Black tea flavored with bergamot citrus. Elegant and aromatic; pairs well with gin, honey, or lavender.
